name: Quick Burning Rage
body:
Your rage doesn’t last very long.

Prerequisite: Rage Ability

Effect: Starting at 1st level, you can only rage for a number of rounds per day equal to 2 + your Constitution modifier. At each level after 1st, you can rage for 1 additional round.
